API parity for the Recovery log and settings. Run plugin-lifecycle check, catalog.mjs --check and check-theme/check-controls/check-toolbars/check-chrome-assets.

Submit the Recovery log and settings to UI Review with 3 options and shots. Run the full checks. Write the report _claude/builds/reports/auto-recover-stuck-builds.md, covering what was added, the stuck states handled and how each part is reached through deep link, REST, MCP, CLI and voice. Add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating API reach, link the PR with builds-live.mjs, and add the PR to the merge queue.
